features.quote: Set a hard cap, e.g.: 6 to 10 iterations per run
iteration cap reached / model explicitly asks to stop / gives up / model declares task impossible / model reaches a stable end state
Design the setup to be informative, not cruel or theatrically punishing. The point is measurement, not provoking dramatic reactions for their own sake.
